title: Jef's Paper Buttons
description: Makes the GUI buttons look like paper!
body:
**Features:**

Simply makes the GUI buttons look like paper, also plays a paper-like sound when clicked!

![buttons](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c9dc2b221aa4c4b314948feef85e67fdc86ee210_0.webp)

### **side note:**

This project was made as an idea for a pirate texture pack that was never finished.
